author: Dr Jamie J. Alnasir, PakAviation.com
comment: Combined Pakistan aerodromes (including private airfields), navigation aids, ATS airspace, prohibited/restricted/danger areas, and provisional TMAs from the five companion GeoJSON datasets. Source publications are primarily Pakistan AIP 2025, supplemented by a 2022 OpenAir reconstruction for Lahore TMA. Preliminary and provisional airspace geometries and operational status require checking against the current AIP and NOTAMs. NOT FOR OPERATIONAL FLIGHT NAVIGATION.
source: Pakistan AIP (Aeronautical Information Publication), AD 2, ENR 2.1 and ENR 5.1 (2025); supplementary 2022 Lahore OpenAir reconstruction
_notice: Combined development dataset: preliminary airspace shapes and provisional TMAs have not been verified for operational use. Karachi TMA lower Class C base is approximated in the CTR; Lahore TMA geometry is provisional. ENR 5.1 prohibited areas lacking published lateral extent are absent.
